capabilities: render interactive star system maps from YAML inside notes
render planet views with moons, rings and imported PNGs
link notes to stars, planets, moons and other celestial bodies
insert pre-formatted starmap and planetview YAML templates
customize colors, sizes and positions of map objects
extras: Licensed CC BY-NC-ND; the author asks for donations but keeps the plugin free. README points to the command palette's "Insert Starmap Template" for the expected YAML format rather than documenting it inline.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to draw interactive star system maps and planet views that link to related notes for worldbuilding.
summary: Starmap plugin that renders interactive star system maps and planet views inside notes from YAML, with note links on celestial bodies.
